name: perfect-vibecoding-rules-nextjs
description: Battle-tested rules for building Next.js apps with Claude Code: code rules, session hand-offs, working with the owner, parallel builder agents, a dev-server keeper and a quality gate. Ships skills, two safety hooks and project templates.

save_chats.title: Save chats in the project
save_chats.description: Copy each session's transcript into the project folder below. The folder ignores itself in git. Transcripts can hold secrets: never commit or share it.

chats_dir.title: Chats folder
chats_dir.description: Folder, relative to the project root, that receives the transcript copies.
